name: SUSFS Side-Channel Probe
description: Detects SUSFS (KernelSU filesystem hiding module) via a side-channel: a child process attempts setresuid and SUSFS kills it with SIGKILL instead of returning EPERM.

evidenceUnits.title: SUSFS syscall side-channel
evidenceUnits.observedObject: Child-process termination behavior during a controlled setresuid probe
evidenceUnits.proposition: The child was terminated with the detector-defined signal pattern instead of returning the expected permission error
evidenceUnits.observationChannel: Forked child, setresuid syscall, and parent wait status
evidenceUnits.availability: Requires process creation, syscall execution, and reliable wait-status collection
evidenceUnits.trustBoundary: The kernel controls syscall and signal behavior and can intentionally imitate or hide the pattern
evidenceUnits.inferenceLimit: The side-channel is associated with tested SUSFS behavior but is not a universal or version-independent proof
